subject: Partner Center referral: Contoso account mapping & field seller alignment
messages:
From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@questcloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>; Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + Partner Center referral for Contoso (account mapping look)

Hi Jordan / Vanessa / Ben,

We're submitting a Partner Center referral for Contoso (attached CSV with the account records we pulled). Michael Reyes (michael.reyes@contoso.com) asked us to put Redwood in front of the renewal conversation — they have an existing Azure estate and are evaluating an inference migration.

Two quick things we hit on our side:
- Partner Center shows two Contoso tenant IDs that look like duplicates (one under an MPN reseller mapping). Not sure which is the canonical Azure subscription for the renewal.
- The field seller that owns the account appears to be different between Partner Center and the field roster (PC lists "A. Martin" as seller; HubSpot shows Michael engaged with "Ben Carter").

Can you confirm who will own the co-sell outreach on Redwood's side? We want to avoid double outreach and ensure the seller gets the referral credit. Attaching contoso_accounts.csv and a simple mapping export.

Proposed next step: internal alignment call (15-20m) to confirm owner + agree outreach sequence, then we (QuestCloud) will route the referral formally in Partner Center.

Thanks — Claire
QuestCloud Partnerships

Attachments:
- contoso_accounts.csv (CSV: account_id, tenant_id, display_name, contact_email)
- proposed-map-v1.xlsx (mapping stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@questcloud.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Partner Center referral for Contoso (account mapping look)

Claire — thanks for the context and the attachments.

High level from our side:
- We should avoid duplicate outreach. I want to validate the Partner Center tenant vs HubSpot canonical account before we route anything.
- Ben has historically been the regional seller for Contoso but Partner Center sometimes surfaces the MPN-assigned seller.

Action items (internal):
1) Ben — can you confirm whether the HubSpot engagement (deal HUBSPOT-987654) is the same Contoso entity and confirm the primary seller you want to own the co-sell?
2) Vanessa — can you run a quick Partner Center ownership check (PC referral view + tenant lookup) and paste the referral link back here?
3) I'll hold on routing until we have confirmation; once Ben confirms, Claire / QuestCloud can push the formal referral and we'll coordinate the outreach template.

If this looks right I'll schedule a 20m sync tomorrow morning (Mon 8/17) at 09:30 PT.

— Jordan
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Partner Center referral for Contoso (account mapping look)

Looping in a quick ownership check approach so we don't block the referral:

- Step A: Partner Center tenant lookup (Vanessa) — confirm tenant GUID and linked MPN. If tenant is listed under a reseller MPN, we need to check consent/ownership; that can create the alternate seller shown in PC.
- Step B: HubSpot canonicalization (Ben) — confirm HubSpot account ID and primary contact; if it's the same legal entity, we treat HubSpot as canonical for outreach.
- Step C: If there's a mismatch, we'll run the "ownership arbitration" flow: temporarily designate a seller for the outreach window (Ben recommended) and record a manual attribution in our partner ledger so the co-sell credit can be reconciled post-close.

Notes: I approved a low-friction manual attribution for this opportunity given the renewal timeline; no program exceptions needed but we should document in the deal record.

Links:
- Partner Center referral (draft): https://partnercenter.microsoft.com/referrals/PC-REF-4432
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654/view

Rishi
Head of Sales Operations

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@questcloud.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro + Partner Center referral for Contoso (account mapping look)

Forwarding back with my findings after partner center lookup. Summary:
- Partner Center shows two tenant GUIDs for "Contoso Corp" (tenant-0a12 and tenant-bf33). tenant-0a12 is the active subscription tied to the renewal (per billing alias), tenant-bf33 is an old MPN-mapped tenant.
- The Partner Center seller flagged (A. Martin) is attached to the old tenant (tenant-bf33). The active subscription tenant points to the seller record matched to Ben Carter's sales region.

I exported the short CSV and attached the filtered rows (contoso_accounts_filtered.csv). My recommendation: treat tenant-0a12 as canonical -> assign outreach ownership to Ben Carter and have QuestCloud submit the referral against tenant-0a12. We'll note the alternate MPN tenant in the deal comments for later reconciliation.

Planned:
- Ben, please confirm you'll be the outreach owner.
- Jordan, please confirm you want QuestCloud to file the referral against tenant-0a12; once they file, we'll accept it and set the owner to Ben.

Attachments:
- contoso_accounts_filtered.csv

Vanessa
Partner Ops

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@questcloud.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Partner Center referral for Contoso (account mapping look)

Thanks — I'll own the outreach.

Ben's next steps:
1) I'll reach out to Michael Reyes (michael.reyes@contoso.com) now to confirm the renewal scope and set a 30m alignment call for this week.
2) Claire / QuestCloud — please submit the Partner Center referral against tenant-0a12 and tag Ben Carter as the field seller in the referral form.
3) Vanessa — once the referral lands in our Partner Center queue, please accept and set the owner to Ben; also paste the PC referral URL back into the HubSpot deal for traceability.
4) Rishi — I'll flag the deal for the manual attribution ledger as discussed.

If anyone has compliance/AM/legal caveats for co-sell routing please flag now; otherwise I'll proceed with outreach and update the thread after the alignment call is scheduled.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
